name: Weather Conditions
description: Rain, snow, fog, or extreme lighting can significantly impact image quality, leading to increased analysis time.

name: Sensor Noise
description: Noise from sensors (e.g., GPS, IMU, barometric) can degrade image data, requiring more processing and analysis.

name: Altitude/Elevation
description: Higher altitudes introduce more complex atmospheric effects, requiring more processing and potentially different classification strategies.

name: Visual Obstructions
description: Buildings, trees, or other objects obstructing the view can complicate image analysis.

name: Camera Calibration Issues
description: Inaccurate camera calibration can introduce systematic biases that affect image quality and classification.

name: Image Resolution
description: Higher resolution images naturally take longer to process.

name: Image Content Complexity
description: Highly complex scenes (many objects, moving elements) require more detailed analysis and potentially more complex classification.

name: Data Bandwidth
description: Transferring large images and processing data can be a bottleneck.

name: Processing Power
description: The UAV's onboard processing capabilities limit the speed of analysis.

name: Data Storage
description: Storing large images can take a significant amount of time.

name: Software/Algorithm Limitations
description: The current image classifier or controller might struggle with certain image characteristics or data distributions.

name: System Configuration
description: Incorrect system settings (e.g., thresholding, filtering) can introduce biases.

name: Data Preprocessing Steps
description: The initial data preprocessing steps (e.g., noise reduction, color correction) can influence the final analysis results.

name: Temporal Variations (If applicable)
description: If multiple images are taken at different times, there could be shifts in image characteristics that affect analysis.
